newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Dunlop reopens for business.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Dunlop reopens for business.

text.p: Tyre maker Dunlop Nigeria Plc said on Thursday it had reopened its factory after a stoppage caused by a demonstration by some of its staff over salary increases.
It said in a statement that business reopened on Wednesday after the closure the day before when some of its 1,000 staff molested and intimidated management over a recent pay award.
Workers who had returned to work had signed an undertaking to maintain industrial peace, a company official said.

The partly government-owned Daily Times newspaper reported on Thursday that 22 Dunlop employees were on Wednesday charged at a magistrate's court with rioting and breaching public peace. They pleaded not guilty.
The staff were offered pay increases of 20-40 percent instead of the 100 percent they had demanded and some who were unhappy with the offer allegedly went on a rampage.
